features.description: Read-only ledger drift detector: for each plan, correlate production evidence (referenced files present on disk/commit, test signals) against plan.md status + features.json passes, and classify each drifted plan as shipped-but-unclosed / operator-gated / superseded / conditional. Pure analysis — no mutation.
steps: Inventory plan artifacts (status, features.passes, evidence_refs, decisions) across docs/plans
Define evidence signals: referenced impl files exist on main; referenced commit reachable; tests present
Implement classifier returning {plan_id, signal, suggested_disposition, evidence[]}
Add CLI surface (e.g. `dontpanic ledger-scan --format text|json`), read-only, exits 0
Fixture tests over synthetic plan dirs (each drift class + a clean plan)
features.acceptance: Given fixture plan dirs, the detector flags each drift class with its suggested disposition and evidence, marks clean plans as clean, never mutates ledger files, and is byte-stable given fixed inputs. Exits 0; --format json validates.

features.description: Closeout ActionItems: project each drifted plan into an ActionItem (audience=operator) offering a disposition menu — Close as completed / Close as superseded / Needs deploy / Needs smoke / Create child plan — each with an exact dontpanic command, plain_consequence, reversible flag, and the evidence refs to capture. Renders on the dashboard via the existing ActionItem spine.
steps: Map each suggested_disposition to an ActionItem with exact_command + plain_consequence + reversible + dashboard_url
Carry F001 evidence refs onto the ActionItem for capture at closeout
Dedupe by dedupe_key; classify audience=operator, requires_human=true
Renderer-parity test: same ActionItem renders in dashboard + what-now JSON
features.acceptance: Each drifted plan yields exactly one operator ActionItem with a valid disposition, exact command, consequence text, reversibility, and evidence refs; renders consistently across dashboard + CLI/JSON deduped by dedupe_key; no secret shapes leak.

features.description: Operator-friendly closeout wiring: extend the existing `close --operator-resolved` path to accept the detector's evidence refs and write status + evidence_refs + a decisions entry, with no agent dispatch. Makes ledger truth-restoration a one-command operator action.
steps: Thread F001 evidence refs into the operator-resolved close path
Record status flip + evidence_refs + decisions entry atomically
Guard: refuse to close as completed without at least one evidence ref
Tests: completed/superseded/child-plan closeouts each record correct ledger state without dispatch
features.acceptance: `dontpanic close --operator-resolved` (or equivalent) flips status, records evidence_refs + a decisions entry, refuses completed-close with zero evidence, and never triggers an agent volley. Verified by fixture tests.
